chunks: And from him, from 'Uthman, from سماعة, from Abī 'Abdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Whoever forgets the wiping of his head or his feet, or anything of the wudu (ablution) that Allah, the Exalted, mentioned in the Qur'an, then wudu (ablution) and salat (prayer) must be repeated by him.

key_terms.إِعَادَةُ: repetition or performing again due to invalidation
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the ritual prayer that must also be repeated
key_terms.الْقُرْآنِ: the Qur'an, cited as the source mentioning the required acts
key_terms.رَأْسِهِ: his head, referring to the obligatory wiping in wudu (ablution)
key_terms.قَدَمَيْهِ: his feet, referring to the obligatory wiping in wudu (ablution)
key_terms.مَسْحَ: wiping as a required act in wudu (ablution)

ai.seo_question: What must someone do if they forget part of wudu (ablution), such as wiping the head or feet?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning omission in wudu (ablution). If a person forgets an essential part of the Qur'an-mentioned acts of wudu (ablution), such as wiping the head or feet, he must repeat both the wudu (ablution) and the salat (prayer).
